sources.title: Piracy monthly report March 2025
sources.text: While the tug boat towing barge was underway, three perpetrators boarded the barge from a sampan and stole some scrap metals from the barge. At the time of the incident, HK Tug 9 and LKH 7887 were escorted by another Singapore-registered tug boat, HK Tug 3. The Singapore Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS) confirmed with HK Tug 3 that the incident had occurred. The Master confirmed that all three perpetrators had disembarked from the barge. The crew was not injured and there was no damage to the vessel.
